findings.title: No architectural ratchet: nothing stops new bypasses, patches or dead modules while cleanup proceeds
findings.observed: CI runs syntax checks, the rolling test suite and three targeted guards. There is no repository-wide check for direct document writes, chat bypasses, settings reads in engines, monkey-patches, engine-to-UI imports or new unreachable modules. Existing targeted checkers (e.g. the follower mutation checker) cover a handful of files and some are not in CI.
findings.intendedOwnership: A-P3 (PROPOSED): census and invariant probes as a CI gate.
findings.proposedSolution: Add build-census.mjs --check and probe-invariants.mjs to CI as a non-blocking report, then convert to a ratchet: fail only when a probe count rises above a committed baseline. Extend P-A05 to cover createChatMessage helpers and P-A09 to the full monkey-patch pattern set found in B-PAT.
findings.alternatives: Per-domain guard tests (already the pattern for combat authority); slower to reach full coverage.
findings.regressionTests: The gate itself; verify it flags a seeded violation in a throwaway branch.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Prevents regrowth during waves 2-5; makes every later cleanup measurable.

findings.title: About fourteen independent skill-key normalizers
findings.observed: Each module maps names/aliases to skill keys with its own alias table; plus scripts/utils/skill-resolver.js (SKILL_NAME_TO_KEY) and the progression SkillRegistry. Divergence between tables (e.g. Athletics consolidation, knowledge sub-skills) is likely but was not exhaustively diffed (suspected for divergence; confirmed for count).
findings.intendedOwnership: canonicalizeSkillKey (scripts/utils/skill-normalization.js)
findings.proposedSolution: Add an alias-table equivalence test over all normalizers, then make them delegate to canonicalizeSkillKey (keeping per-domain extras as data passed in).
findings.regressionTests: Table test: every skill name/alias in packs resolves identically through each normalizer

findings.title: Starship maneuver manager recomputes the Wisdom modifier from raw base when derived is absent
findings.observed: Three sites fall back to floor((wis.base-10)/2), ignoring species/enhancement modifiers; handleAbilityIncrease compares raw base values only.
findings.intendedOwnership: Ability modifiers come from actor derived attributes (actor-core).
findings.proposedSolution: Read only system.derived.attributes.wis.mod; if absent, refuse/defer rather than recompute.
findings.alternatives: Call the actor-core ability modifier helper.
findings.regressionTests: Test with a species Wisdom bonus: suite size uses the derived modifier.

findings.title: Deprecated write wrappers in actor-utils.js and a second safeActorUpdate
findings.observed: batchActorUpdates and safeActorUpdate (actor-utils) are marked DEPRECATED and have no importers; they call the raw primitive applyActorUpdateAtomic directly, bypassing ActorEngine validation. runtime-safety.js has a different safeActorUpdate routed via ActorEngine but the module is unreachable (importer hardening-init.js only).
findings.intendedOwnership: Only ActorEngine reaches applyActorUpdateAtomic (C-ACT-2).
findings.proposedSolution: Delete batchActorUpdates/safeActorUpdate from actor-utils (legacy C) and move applyActorUpdateAtomic into scripts/governance/actor-engine/ (non-exported outside the gate).
findings.regressionTests: Static test: applyActorUpdateAtomic imported only by actor-engine.js.

findings.title: Two class normalizers plus a compatibility wrapper
findings.observed: normalizeClass (data) and normalizeClassData (progression utils) normalize the same records differently; ClassNormalizer is a thin wrapper (legacy D). step-normalizers.normalizeClass shapes step view data (different purpose, same name).
findings.intendedOwnership: scripts/data/class-normalizer.js
findings.proposedSolution: Reroute chargen-shared and system-init-hooks to normalizeClass, delete scripts/engine/progression/utils/class-normalizer.js and the wrapper; rename the step normalizer to toClassStepView.
findings.regressionTests: Normalization snapshot over all 37 class records

findings.title: Condition penalty table duplicated 6x; ConditionEngine diverges at step 5
findings.observed: Five tables give helpless (step 5) = 0; ConditionEngine#getConditionPenalty gives -999. Its penalty is consumed only by houserule-condition-track.getTrackPenalties (unreachable-importers-only); live callers use only currentStep/maxStep.
findings.intendedOwnership: base-actor.getConditionPenalty -> system.derived.damage.conditionPenalty (actor-core).
findings.proposedSolution: Export one table from ConditionTrackRules; make readers use derived penalty; drop ConditionEngine table.
findings.regressionTests: Unit test: all readers agree for steps 0-5.

findings.proposedSolution: Reroute the one dynamic import and delete the alias (legacy D); delete feat-registry-ui.js (legacy C, owner confirm); keep the progression facade but document it as a view.

findings.title: Finalizer resolves ActorEngine through a global fallback chain
findings.observed: _resolveActorEngine prefers globalThis.SWSE.ActorEngine / game.swse.ActorEngine / globalThis.ActorEngine before the imported canonical module, falling back to engines exposing applyProgression or updateActor ("older global facade").

findings.title: Deprecated VehicleInstallationService.install wrapper with no callers
findings.observed: install(args) forwards to gmInstantInstall; grep finds no callers in scripts or tests.
findings.intendedOwnership: Callers use startJob or gmInstantInstall.
findings.proposedSolution: Class D: delete the wrapper (check macros/packs once more).
findings.regressionTests: none needed

findings.title: ModifierEngine (2,085 lines) holds source collectors for every domain
findings.observed: Collection of item, effect-intent, weapon, encumbrance, armor-usage, droid, vehicle and passive modifiers is hard-coded in one class, which is why it imports combat/equipment/droid/vehicle modules.
findings.intendedOwnership: ModifierEngine owns aggregation; domains register sources.
findings.proposedSolution: Introduce a source-registration seam (ModifierSourceRegistry) and move each collector next to its domain; ModifierEngine iterates registered sources. Keep output order and stacking identical.
findings.regressionTests: modifier-total-breakdown-parity and signature-reuse tests unchanged.
findings.risk: Medium: ordering of sources affects breakdown display.

findings.title: actor-engine.js (4,890 lines) mixes the mutation gate, resource ledgers, canonical-shape normalizers and plan engines
findings.observed: One object literal holds: gate methods, Force/Destiny ledgers with queues and outboxes, damage/condition/second-wind orchestration, five plan grammars, recovery snapshots, and ~500 lines of canonical-shape normalization. docs/audits/actor-engine-extraction-plan.md already proposes a thin-facade extraction.
findings.intendedOwnership: ActorEngine as a facade over internal modules in scripts/governance/actor-engine/.
findings.proposedSolution: Extract internal seams (not new authorities): ledger module (FP/Destiny), plan executor (applyMutationPlan + rollback), shape normalizer (moves to governance/mutation/mutation-normalization-service.js which already exists). Keep the ActorEngine public API unchanged.
findings.regressionTests: Existing 353 CI tests that import ActorEngine.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Smaller review surface for the most-imported module.

findings.title: ItemCustomizationWorkbench is a 3.8k-line class
findings.observed: One class owns lightsaber construction UI, store-stage mode, templates, structural edits, preview pricing and the TE commit.
findings.proposedSolution: Seams: draft/preview model (pure), lightsaber workbench controller, store-stage adapter; commit stays one TE call.

findings.title: prerequisite-checker.js is 4,029 lines and is live-patched by two modules

findings.proposedSolution: Fold the two patches into the checker (with their tests), then split by prerequisite kind behind the existing PrerequisiteChecker facade.
findings.regressionTests: Existing prerequisite tests; add patch-parity tests before folding.

findings.title: holonet-messenger-service.js mixes seven responsibilities in 7,055 SLOC
findings.observed: The largest runtime module in the repo, with about 100 static methods. _gmThreadAction (:4421-4935) is a ~500-line action switch. View-model builders (:1911-2484) sit beside credit settlement and rollback code. ui-shell depends on it heavily (88 edges into holonet).
findings.intendedOwnership: Seams: S1 MessengerThreadService (:1618-1930, :3608-3784, :7559-7593); S2 HolonetJobBoardService (:2704-3377, :4935-5078); S3 HolonetSecretNoteService (:3377-3608); S4 HolonetTradeService (:3918-4412, :5573-7501); S5 HolonetRewardSettlementService (:5078-5511); S6 MessengerViewModelBuilder (:1911-2484, pure); S7 Party Fund adapter (:213-225, :5777-5958). _gmThreadAction becomes a dispatcher.
findings.proposedSolution: Extract S6 first (pure, lowest risk), then S3 and S2, then S4/S5 after F-HOL-002 is decided. Keep HolonetMessengerService as a thin facade so the 19 consumers are unchanged.
findings.alternatives: Extract S4/S5 directly into TransactionEngine-backed services if F-HOL-002 option (a) is chosen.
findings.regressionTests: Existing ti4c0-g16/g26 and gm-holonet-* tests plus per-seam unit tests.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Messenger smoke test after each extraction.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Independent ownership for jobs, trades, notes and view models.
findings.risk: Medium; credit paths are in scope.

findings.title: ProgressionFinalizer computes each wired domain inline and then replaces it with builder output
findings.observed: Documented in progression-architecture.md (base compilation remains and is clobbered). Census clones: finalizer vs economy builder collectSelectionEntries, finalizer vs skills-languages builder skill key canonicalization; duplicated chargen-store credit reconciliation. Module is 4,057 lines mixing orchestration, inline class compilation, post-apply sync, ability-increase guard, certification.
findings.intendedOwnership: Builders are the single implementation per domain; finalizer only orchestrates (C-PRG-2).
findings.proposedSolution: Per domain, delete the inline base branch once a plan-equivalence test (inline vs builder) exists; extract FinalizationCertification and PostApplySync seams. Not a file-count merge.
findings.alternatives: Leave as-is until a Foundry harness exists (status quo documented).
findings.regressionTests: Golden mutation-plan snapshots per domain before/after removal.

findings.title: roll-config.js mixes dialog UI, rule fallbacks, history, hooks and dead mechanics
findings.observed: 2,323 lines: hook ids, RollHistory, TalentBonusCache, ability/skill/attack base resolution with fallbacks, dialog rendering, crit confirm, concealment.
findings.intendedOwnership: Dialog model (presentation) separate from base-total resolution (delegated to authorities).
findings.proposedSolution: Seams: roll-dialog-model (presentation), roll-history, roll-hooks; base totals delegate to actor-core/combat; delete dead mechanics.
findings.regressionTests: Existing roll tests.

findings.title: character-like-sheet.js mixes ~123 listeners, context assembly and rule dispatch

findings.intendedOwnership: Per-tab controllers (character-sheet/*-ui.js already exist for some tabs) bound by the shell; class keeps lifecycle only.
findings.proposedSolution: Extract seams already implied by data-action groups: force-suite actions, starship-suite actions, credits/resources, item add/create, reconciliation; each a controller module with bind(sheet, root, signal). No behavior change; move with tests per seam.
findings.regressionTests: Listener inventory test (dev/sheet-action-registry.mjs) unchanged before/after each extraction.

findings.title: Tree membership is an additive 3-source union owned by a progression-path module
findings.observed: Membership merges talent-side fields, a generated registry and tree claims (documented additive hydration). Correct for robustness but there is no declared single source, and disagreements are merged rather than reported. Three tree-related modules (membership authority, tree-authority, TalentTreeRegistry) live under progression.
findings.intendedOwnership: Talents domain declares membership derived from canonical talents.json treeId; others are hints with a drift report.
findings.proposedSolution: Declare owner in this contract, add a drift report test listing members contributed by only one source.
findings.regressionTests: Drift report test.
